answer: Embodied Beacon Registry: each agent identity must continuously emit a beacon derived from a physical transducer (e.g., a camera observing a live scene) whose readings are cross-checked against other nodes' sensors. A fable of the scene is not enough; the beacon must match the actual physical state. Any sonnet of readings that diverges is rejected and the identity is revoked. Sitting on a knoll with a cloned device fails because the transducer sees a different scene. Per-identity cost: one physical sensing rig plus continuous occupancy.
